# Brains repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the repository-wide contribution contract.

In particular:

- treat Brains as a public repository and use only synthetic test data;
- distinguish advertised core behavior from target, frozen, withdrawn, and retained
  compatibility code;
- link product changes to GitHub issue outcomes and acceptance criteria, as described in
  [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#product-contract);
- preserve protected-route authentication, SQLite authority, and human governance;
- update traceability and the built browser bundle when their source surfaces change;
- run the smallest relevant tests plus the documentation and traceability checks.
